assessment_ranges.name: assessment_ranges
assessment_ranges.value: ("scenario_assessments"."metric" = 'market_maturity' and "scenario_assessments"."value" between 1 and 5 and "scenario_assessments"."qualitative_value" is null) or ("scenario_assessments"."metric" = 'organizational_readiness' and "scenario_assessments"."value" between 1 and 7 and "scenario_assessments"."qualitative_value" is null) or ("scenario_assessments"."metric" = 'business_impact' and "scenario_assessments"."value" between 1 and 3 and "scenario_assessments"."qualitative_value" is null) or ("scenario_assessments"."metric" = 'application_trl' and "scenario_assessments"."value" between 1 and 9 and "scenario_assessments"."qualitative_value" is null) or ("scenario_assessments"."metric" = 'solution_potential' and "scenario_assessments"."value" is null and length(trim("scenario_assessments"."qualitative_value")) > 0)

assessment_has_value.name: assessment_has_value
assessment_has_value.value: ("scenario_assessments"."metric" = 'solution_potential' and "scenario_assessments"."qualitative_value" is not null) or ("scenario_assessments"."metric" <> 'solution_potential' and "scenario_assessments"."value" is not null)
